description: This file contains functions and variables related to platform-specific upgrades for certain TP-Link networking devices, including configuring MTD partition layout and performing firmware upgrades.

methods.name: tplink_sg2xxx_fix_mtdparts
methods.description: Configures the MTD partition layout and baudrate for TP-Link SG2xxx series devices.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Performs a check on the firmware image; currently always returns success.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the upgrade process, configuring partitions for specific devices based on their board name.
